{{Top}}
{{Quote|We're not police and we're not medicos. We're journalists, and our first duty is to report the facts.|[[Madhi Vaandt]]|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Vortex">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]''</ref>}}
A '''journalist''' or '''reporter''' was someone who reported on events for a living in the news media. These events included anything from the [[Death/Legends|death]] of a [[Politics/Legends|political]] leader to the [[Marriage/Legends|marriage]] of a [[Holodrama/Legends|Holodrama]] celebrity.

==History==
{{Quote|We didn't have journalists on my planet, so I really don't understand how your mind works. But if you could take this blaster and shoot at the things about to tear us apart&mdash;while you talk to those cams&mdash;it would be appreciated.|[[Arbeloa]], to [[Cianba]], during the [[Battle of Shramar]]|<ref name="Invasion: Revelations 5">[[Invasion: Revelations 5|''Invasion: Revelations'' 5]]</ref>}}
[[File:Cianba_Shramar.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[Cianba]], a journalist reporting a [[Battle of Shramar|battle]] with her [[Holocamera/Legends|holocamera]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]]]

[[Den Dhur]] and [[Hallis Saper]] were two notable journalists, and ''[[The Perre Needmo Newshour]]'' was a famous journalistic [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] show, hosted by respected anchor [[Perre Needmo]].

Sometimes, when reporting cases of great danger, journalists were injured or killed. One journalist killed while reporting was the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Madhi Vaandt]], who in [[44 ABY]], reported on the killing of [[Octusi]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] by [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] during a slave [[Blaudu Sextus revolt|rebellion]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Blaudu Sextus]] and was killed by [[Belok Rhal]], the leader of the Mandalorians.
